text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... This restaurant is booked out,
too...
What should I do about the party
venue?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Father will be back in Japan soon, but I
don't
have anything ready! At this rate...
Ohhh...
Urgh... What should I dooo?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rice! Oh, I know! Um, there's
something I'd
like your help with!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I see. The fishmonger you're friends with
has a
new grandchild on the way, and
you want to buy
the baby a picture book
as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! But there are so many to pick
from! Can
you help me choose one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sure! I'd be glad to help!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Since it's going to be for a baby, I think

something easy to understand would be
best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then how about a pop-up book?
The baby
can have fun just looking at it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fairy tales would be good too. They
have clear
themes and can still be
enjoyed after the child
grows up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Nice! A fairy tale, huh? Great
suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two Umamusume spend
several hours
scouring a number of
bookstores.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy! We found the perfect fairy tale
pop-up
book!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ack! When did it get so dark out?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Rice! I took up so much of
your time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Don't worry. It's fine. I had a lot of
fun
today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I like seeing you so happy, Urara.
So there's
no need to feel guil—

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay to rely on us, Rice. We'd be
more than
happy to help you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if the way I feel now is how
Father and
Mother felt back then...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (If that's the case, then...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Urara? I've actually got a bit of a
problem
myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to hold a party for my parents and
show
them a good time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I can't get anything done on my
own...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And so, um, Urara... Could you please
help me
out?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wha?! You want me to help you?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will! I want to put a big smile
on your
face, too, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we should try asking others for help
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know everyone will be more than
happy to pitch
in for your sake, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara... Okay! Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot, Fine! Let's go with that for
the
venue!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll have to order catering from the
restaurant
Curren recommended too.
And after that... After
that is...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, umm... I'm looking for a place where
we can
rehearse for the party...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want this to be an absolute success, so
I need to
make sure the preparations are
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want this to be an absolute success, so
I need to
make sure the preparations are
perfect!
choice_data_list: きっと楽しいパーティーになるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure it'll be a fun party.
I'll help look for it too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too! Especially since
everyone is
working so hard for my sake!
choice_data_list: きっと楽しいパーティーになるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure it'll be a fun party.
I'll help look for it too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for hearing me out. I'm going to
keep
searching for a suitable place!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you! I really appreciate it!
choice_data_list: 力になれたら嬉しいから
choice_data_list_en: Because I'd be happy if I could help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go around the academy with Rice
Shower, and
we manage to borrow the
cafeteria for her
rehearsal. I really hope
her plan is a big success.
